Bettina, I haven't set up the digest yet. The scheduler rejected the request because the Gateway isn't configured with the credentials it needs to save jobs (its schedule list also failed for the same reason). Nothing is scheduled, so no digest will post on Monday until this is fixed. An admin needs to check the Gateway's auth configuration. Once the scheduler works, I'll set it up for Mondays at 08:00 Chicago time, starting Monday 19 October, posting here in #coastal-team.

Two things I plan to build in:
- The digest will read #coastal-team and #coastal-random only. Both channels have the same four members (you, Kwame, Sofia and me), so the content stays within that group.
- It will leave out money terms (rates, prices, discounts, contract values, invoices, payment terms). Those aren't mine to post in a channel, so for any item that depends on one, the digest will just say that finance details need to go to the account owner.
